column1: # Upstream sources of vendored and adapted skills, one row per source path.
# Columns (tab-separated): skill, GitHub repo, path in that repo ("." = whole repo),
# pinned commit = the last upstream commit already reviewed for this skill.
# This file is the only place a pin lives; Source comments and SOURCES.md only credit.
# scripts/check-upstreams.sh lists every row with commits on its path past the pin,
# and .github/workflows/upstreams.yml runs it weekly into one upstream-drift issue.
# Refresh a reported row: read the compare link it prints, limited to the row's path,
# port what fits the local adaptation (local divergences win), then move the pin to
# the latest commit the report named. A row with nothing worth porting gets its pin
# moved too, so the next report stays quiet.
# ui-polish has no rows: it reads its references from live clones (update-refs.sh).
